about_short_description.short_description: Miden is a debit card issuance platform for businesses in Africa.

product.name: Card Issuing
product.description: Infrastructure for businesses to issue and manage payment cards, including virtual corporate cards, spend controls, and card programs on supported networks.

product.name: Banking as a Service
product.description: Financial infrastructure that enables businesses to embed account, collection, payment, and other banking functions into their workflows.

product.name: Expense Management
product.description: A spend-management service for monitoring organizational expenses, routing requests for approval, and managing team or departmental spending accounts.

product.name: Wallet as a Service
product.description: Infrastructure for businesses to create and manage digital wallets for storing funds and supporting payments within their own products or workflows.

product.name: Global Payments
product.description: Payment infrastructure for businesses that need to support payment activity across markets and currencies.

product.name: Bill Payments
product.description: A business payment service for processing and managing bill-related transactions through Miden’s payment infrastructure.
